entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I hope you can help. I bought some road cycling shoes a little while ago, and I need to return them. I just feel so bad about it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti, order number is VF77890. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I've never returned anything before. I really needed these to work out.
Thank you, Maria. I see the order right here. Just so I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the fit?

It's the fit. They just... they gave me terrible blisters. I tried adjusting the cleats a few times, thinking that might help, but it didn't. I just can't wear these cycling shoes without being in pain. It's really disappointing.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the return policy for you. One moment.
Okay. I just... I really hope I can get a refund. With the holidays, things are a bit tight and I could really use that money back.

Alright Maria, I've reviewed your order. I see it was delivered 47 days ago. Our standard policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can absolutely process this return for you for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief! Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so worried.

Of course. I'm happy to help. I've just emailed you a prepaid return shipping label. Just pack the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off at any post office. Once we receive them, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. You've been incredibly helpful. Thank you again.
You're very welcome, Maria. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a great day!
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
